mutations.name: W1 the nonzero-frontier-carries-its-cursor guard is dropped, so a recovery adopts at the current end and the unread appended record is skipped with no seq gap
mutations.find:
if ((f.seq > 0 || f.lastSubjectSeq > 0) && typeof f.sourceCursor !== "string")
    throw new WalCorruptError(path, "a nonzero frontier carries its sourceCursor", JSON.stringify(f));
mutations.expectRed: [F2] a NONZERO frontier with its sourceCursor deleted is refused

mutations.name: W2 the both-zero-or-both-nonzero frontier guard is dropped, so a pair no shipped transition can produce loads
mutations.find:
if ((f.seq === 0) !== (f.lastSubjectSeq === 0))
    throw new WalCorruptError(path, "frontier.seq and lastSubjectSeq are both zero or both nonzero", JSON.stringify(f));
mutations.expectRed: [F2] a MIXED frontier pair (seq 0, lastSubjectSeq 7) is impossible and refused

mutations.name: W3 the pending-shape guard is dropped, so an absent key is silently read as an explicit null and an uncertain frame is reclassified as clean
mutations.expectRed: [F3] a document whose `pending` KEY IS ABSENT is refused, not read as null

mutations.name: W4 the clobber refusal is dropped and the write path passes through again, so a stale handle rewrites a folded frontier to a tip the broker never assigned
mutations.find:
await this.assertNotClobbering();
    const stamped: WalDoc = { ...next, gen: this.doc.gen + 1 };
mutations.expectRed: [G2] a stale handle is refused on a transition whose ONLY refusal is inside the write
mutations.note: Re-pointed. Every [G] cell drives the stale handle through `recordAck`, which now carries an EARLIER copy of this refusal so it cannot move the principal's shared record on its way to failing. That copy answered for the whole section, and this mutation SURVIVED with another mutation in the same file killed in the same run: a coverage gap, not an unreached file. [G2] drives `advanceCursorOnly`, which has no early check of its own, so the refusal it grades is the one inside `write`.

mutations.name: W5 an absent generation is read as zero instead of refused, so a document with the guard stripped out of it loads and every later write compares against a value nobody wrote
mutations.find:
if (!isSafeNonNegInt(doc.gen))
    throw new WalCorruptError(path, "gen is a safe non-negative integer", `found gen=${String(doc.gen)} on a v${String(doc.v)} document`);
mutations.expectRed: [G] a v3 document with `gen` STRIPPED is refused, not read as generation 0
